Therefore, he lost his father early in this life and will have to undergo difficulties thereafter… If the native recites Gayatri Japa 5000 to 10000 times in the presence of a Guru, he will be able to get rid of the curse and will have a good turn in his life and be happy."
Effect of the rule: The curse lifted, if the remedy is performed.
Combination of the rule: The Sun aspected by Saturn, Venus in the 12th from the Sun; the father short-lived.

Rule description: The name-tableau, a third full demonstration
Exact rule: The method's third full working, and the body-part code is stable across all three: > Ch 139 — "Jupiter is in a king's house and holds Chief Minister's post. The other > occupant is Mars who is reddish in colour and there is Ketu with a tail. So, the native > will have the name of a faithful servant having a tail. With Venus placed in the 2nd to > Jupiter we can infer his name to be Sugriva." And three shorter derivations: Ch 114 — Ketu in Aries ("rocky soil") with Rahu "in a stable foundation" gives "the name of the deity on Seshachala Hills"; Ch 107 — Venus with Jupiter, Mars and Rahu in the previous signs gives a name "of the dynasty of Parasurama — as for example Jamuna, Renuka"; Ch 142 — Jupiter in Leo, "a kingly house", with Ketu gives "a name as Raja or one beginning with those letters."
Effect of the rule: The native's name, or its first or last letters.
Combination of the rule: The planets around Jupiter are read as parts of a figure (RAO-FND-027, RAO-PBR-013).

Rule description: Propitiation of a specific planet, and of a specific deity for a specific want
Exact rule: The remedies in this block are the most precisely targeted in the corpus, and two of them are addressed to planets rather than to gods: | Chart | The want | The remedy | |---|---|---| | Ch 189 | "He may not have any daughters" | "This can be warded off by propitiating Kanyaka Parameshwari" — the goddess of maidens, for the lack of daughters | | Ch 168 | The wife's wind troubles and piles | "Medication and propitiation of Ketu and the Moon will give her relief" — note medication first | | Ch 176 | Obstruction from Mars and Rahu in the contact order | "He will have to propitiate Mars and Rahu" — the offending planets themselves | | Ch 187 | Restlessness, financial loss, no peace of mind | "propitiating Lord Siva by Rudrabhisheka ceremony" | | Ch 199 | The wife's obstinate nature | "propitiating god Skanda, and doing Pooja of Lord Siva" | | Ch 184 | "He has a curse" | "will overcome its effects by propitiating gods" | | Ch 178 | General trouble | "propitiating the nine planets" (RAO-PBR-020)
Effect of the rule: Relief aimed at the specific lack.
Combination of the rule: A named affliction or a named lack.

Rule description: The palm and the chart are read INTO each other
Exact rule: This block settles what RAO-PBR-018, 019 and 022 could only indicate: the palm is not a supplement to the chart — the two are read as one system, in BOTH directions. - Palm → chart (Ch 212): "The Mars line in the hand of this native has assumed the form of a serpent. Next on the Mount of Moon there is serpent line visible. So, we have to conclude that the native will have both Mars and Cancer being influenced by Rahu and Ketu." — the hand is used to infer the planetary configuration. - Chart → palm (Ch 265): "Rahu comes between Mars and Venus in this horoscope. The native, therefore, has a line resembling the serpent's mouth at the end of his line of Mars in his palm." — the chart is used to predict the hand. - Palm as verdict (Ch 241): "The Rahu line and the Ketu line in the palm of this native indicate that Rahu and Ketu have gobbled up all good fortune, leaving the native bereft of any happiness." - Further signs named: "tail-like lines on his palms" (Ch 223); "two circular signs on the mount of the Moon … signs of triangles on the Jupiter and Mars mounts" (Ch 233); "the line of longevity is shaped like a snake" (Ch 254); "a fish sign in 3rd phalange of Jupiter finger" (Ch 145).
Effect of the rule: Verdicts the horoscope alone does not supply.

Rule description: Remedies: the list completed
Exact rule: Added to RAO-PBR-004, 015, 020 and 025: | Chart | The trouble | The remedy | Note | |---|---|---|---| | Ch 213 | Legal trouble over a house; loss of both parents | "By propitiating the gods for a period of 21 days" | a counted rite, like the 48 Mondays of RAO-PBR-005 | | Ch 222 | A forced change of place at 48–49 | "It can be averted by doing Japa and performing of religious ceremonies" | a remedy stated to avert a dated event, not merely soften it | | Ch 221 | "He will have more daughters than sons" | "By propitiating the family deity one son will be born" | the targeting principle of RAO-PBR-025 | | Ch 250 | General | "benefitted by worshipping Kumara, Guru and by performing meditation" | | | Ch 275 | "this woman … will bear no children" | "Yet, she will do well to pray to Lord Skanda" | offered even where the verdict is flat denial
Effect of the rule: Relief, or aversion.

Rule description: The cow-curse, a second time — and the same remedy
Exact rule: Two charts, ~215 printed pages apart, carry the same offence and the same prescription: | | Chart 44 | Chart 379 | |---|---|---| | The offence | "gave a blow to a calf … as a result it died" | "hit a cow which was carrying … the cow and the calf in the uterus died" | | The consequence | "suffer from suffocating cough as the calf suffered" | "so he got a curse" — wealth withheld despite exalted planets | | The remedy | "feeding Brahmins and giving away a cow in charity" | "service to elders, learned men and giving away a cow as charity"
Effect of the rule: A specific present-life deprivation, with a matched release.
Combination of the rule: A chart's dignities promise wealth and none arrives.

Rule description: The previous birth is the 12th from the relevant karaka
Exact rule: RAO-PBR-001 gave the rule for the native, from Jupiter. Here the Master states it generally, and applies it to the FATHER, from the Sun: > "The disciple wants to know how this happened and how it can be judged from the combination of > planets in the chart. The Master answers — The previous birth is indicated by the 12th sign to > the position of the Sun in this birth. Because of the Sun in Capricorn you get a knowledge of the > previous birth."
Effect of the rule: The named offence and its present-life consequence. Here: the father abused Sadhus who came for alms, was cursed, and "will lose his brothers and sons in this life."
Combination of the rule: Whose previous birth is being read determines which karaka to count from.

Rule description: The remedies of the closing section: the most detailed in the book
Exact rule: The closing readings give complete rites — place, duration, offering, recipient — and they follow RAO-PBR-015 exactly: the remedy answers the offence in kind. | The offence | The prescription | |---|---| | Denied a poor Brahmin woman her wages for supplying water; she cursed him to "lose his wife and children early" | "go on a pilgrimage to Vedaranyam in Tamil Nadu and there stay for a week and worship the Lord. He should offer as gifts clothes to a Brahmin widow and feed her and her children. Then, by the grace of the Lord and the blessings of the lady, he would be freed" — the very class of person wronged is the one whose blessing lifts it | | Caused a still-birth by black magic after being rebuked by a widow | "in the company of his wife, go on a pilgrimage to Mamayapuram, and for a fortnight observe celibacy, then offer food to holymen and worship Lord Shiva daily. On the last day the wife should offer clothes and money to ten people … Then return and practise Krittika Vrata commencing with an auspicious Monday" | | A curse costing him wife and children in every birth | "make a small image of silver of a child and offer it to Lord Balaji of Tirupati. He should shower gold pieces on the head of Lord Subramanya and worship him. After this, the effect of the curse will cease to exist" — a silver child for children denied
Effect of the rule: The curse lifted, if the rite is performed.
Combination of the rule: A previous-birth curse has been identified.

Rule description: Empty adjacent signs to Saturn: no settled career
Exact rule: The purest possible test of RAO-FND-009 — the master rule says to read the adjacent houses of the karaka; here there is nothing in them, and the verdict follows directly from that emptiness. Verbatim: "In this case, there are no planets in the adjoining houses to the house occupied by Saturn. Hence, the native will have no specific settlement in life and will change his profession frequently. He will be greatly in debts."
Effect of the rule: No settled profession; frequent changes; heavy debt.
Combination of the rule: No planets in either sign adjacent to the one Saturn occupies.

Rule description: What stands in the 2nd from Saturn names the concern
Exact rule: "Saturn has Venus in the 2nd house of his own position and indicates involvement in a financial concern" (Ch 16 — Venus = money, RAO-KRK-007). And in Chart 2, "with the placement of Mars and Venus in the 2nd house to Saturn, he will own house, have conveyances and earn well."
Effect of the rule: The kind of concern the native works in.
Combination of the rule: A planet occupies the sign next after Saturn's.

Rule description: What stands in the 7th from Saturn names the setting
Exact rule: Three worked cases, and note how differently they read — - Mercury in the 7th from Saturn → "he will be employed in a rich concern" (Ch 17). - Jupiter and Ketu in the 7th to Saturn → "the native will live by earning from propitiations to the Divine, doing pious deeds and living an austere life" (Ch 19). - Mars in the 7th house to Saturn → "He will earn as a low paid servant, in a king's court entrance (Ketu in Leo)" (Ch 23).
Effect of the rule: Where the native works, and how highly he stands there.
Combination of the rule: A planet stands in the 7th from Saturn.

Rule description: The signs after Saturn, read in order, are the career timeline
Exact rule: The finest single example in the batch — verbatim: "Although, Saturn is well placed in the house of Fortune, the second therefrom is unoccupied, the 3rd is occupied by debilitated Mars, and Ketu is placed in the 4th. These dispositions will cause impediments all along his life and career. He will start with writing until the influence of Mars and Ketu is over, and when Saturn contacts Venus in his own house, he will come into lime light. As Saturn contacts Mercury and the Sun in the next house, the native will enter into a treasury section and obtain great name and fame — but he will have only very ordinary comforts."
Effect of the rule: A career of impediments early (empty 2nd, debilitated Mars, Ketu), writing as the first occupation, then prominence at Venus, then a treasury post with fame but modest comfort.
Combination of the rule: Saturn is well placed, but the signs following him are read one by one.

Rule description: The occupation is compounded from Saturn's itinerary
Exact rule: Read the planets met as a compound noun, not severally: | Chart | Saturn meets, in order | Occupation named | |---|---|---| | Ch 11 | Rahu → Mars (→ Sun-Venus, Mercury) | Wood sawing / timber — "dry wood… a clever way of giving new shape to the dry forest wood products" | | Ch 9 | Venus + Mercury → Sun, Mars, Rahu | Money lending and dealing in jewellery | | Ch 6 | Rahu → Venus + Moon (exchanging with Mercury) | Drinks and dresses, business in various places, and conveyances as an employee
Effect of the rule: A specific, named occupation.
Combination of the rule: Saturn's forward contact order is listed.

Rule description: Saturn in Mercury's sign: intellectual and accounting work
Exact rule: "The native will be employed in an intellectual concern as Saturn is in Mercury's house. Though, Ketu creates obstructions, the native will rise high as the Sun is powerful in his own house with Mercury. He will be employed in an Accounts Department but will not rise high."
Effect of the rule: Accounts department; high birth, subordinate rank; late turn to religious work.
Combination of the rule: Saturn occupies a sign owned by Mercury; the Sun is strong in his own house with Mercury.

Rule description: Mercury and Mars together give engineering; the sign's lord gives the setting
Exact rule: "The Sun-Saturn combination indicates Government. Mercury exalted in Virgo aspected by Mars in Pisces indicates mastery of machinery. So he will hold a high post in water supply engineering department."
Effect of the rule: A senior technical post under government.
Combination of the rule: Mercury exalted in Virgo, aspected by Mars from Pisces; the Sun-Saturn pair present.

Rule description: The father's profession is read from the Sun by the same frame
Exact rule: The method is scale-free — swap the karaka and everything else stays. Worked: | Chart | Configuration | Father's livelihood | |---|---|---| | Ch 6 | Sun in Gemini with Venus, Mercury in the 2nd to the Sun | "a trader dealing in many things" | | Ch 3 | Sun walking forward meets Mars + Rahu, then Saturn + Moon | "machinery and judiciary" | | Ch 17 | Sun has Mercury in Leo | "commercial minded" | | Ch 19 | Sun-Mercury in Taurus, Venus in Cancer | "Vedic educational service, and own lands and houses" | | Ch 26 | Sun in the next house, aspected by Jupiter in Aries | "honoured by Government and occupy a high position"; Mars in the next house to the Sun → landed property | | Ch 13 | Sun with Saturn and Venus in the next house | "the native's father will also have some enemies" — but the Sun's exaltation "has given him power … he will win over his enemies"
Effect of the rule: The father's trade, his standing and his property.
Combination of the rule: The Sun is taken as the karaka and the same frame applied to him.

Rule description: Jupiter delivers the post; Saturn only earns it
Exact rule: Ask what work of Saturn; ask when it pays, and how well of Jupiter.
Effect of the rule: The appointment, the rank, the emolument.
Combination of the rule: Jupiter in transit contacts the planets that carry the profession.

Rule description: Fame and gain dated from the karaka's contacts
Exact rule: The book states career fortune as a run of dated windows, favourable and otherwise, without naming the mechanism each time: - Ch 17 — "He will earn name and fame in his 34-35th years. He will then have financial gains also, and 2-3 years later income from landed property is indicated." - Ch 20 — "Troubles will arise in 6th, 11th, 29th, 33rd and 37th years and then again in 69th and 70th years. He will have Yoga (favourable period) from 30-31 and reach great heights when he is 42-43. … Just after 57 upto 63, he will have good financial gains."
Effect of the rule: A year-by-year career forecast.

Rule description: Jupiter in Scorpio: high ambition, early trouble, eventual wealth
Exact rule: "With Jupiter placed in Scorpio the native will have very high ambitions. As Jupiter has Saturn in the 7th to him the native will have troubles in his 5th year but will become a rich man."
Effect of the rule: High ambition, early obstruction, wealth in the end.
Combination of the rule: Jupiter in Scorpio with Saturn in the 7th to him.

Rule description: Empty adjacency to Saturn also denies brothers and helpers
Exact rule: Chart 58 extends RAO-PRF-001 in three directions at once: "Saturn is in Sagittarius with no planet placed in the adjoining houses. He has no brothers. He has medium education. He has none to help him." Chart 31 adds the same for a whole trio: "As the trio (Venus, Mercury and Saturn) are not aspected by any planet and have no planets in the next house, the profession will be a laborious one."
Effect of the rule: Isolation in work and in family alike.
Combination of the rule: No planets in the signs adjoining Saturn's.

Rule description: The sign lord and the sign's subject name the trade together
Exact rule: A second, purely static route to the same answer that RAO-PRF-005 reaches dynamically: | Chart | Configuration | Trade | |---|---|---| | Ch 34 | Saturn in Virgo | "the native will be a merchant"; with Jupiter there, also "learned in religious texts" | | Ch 33 | Saturn in "the commercial house of Virgo" with Jupiter and Rahu | "The native will follow his grandfather's profession" | | Ch 48 | Mercury in Libra, Saturn in the next house | "a merchant by profession"; Saturn conjunct Ketu, Mercury with the Sun → "the place of employment will be a co-operative concern" | | Ch 49 | Saturn in the house of Mars, conjunct Ketu | "the field of profession is one of machines" | | Ch 56 | Saturn conjunct Mercury, Venus in the next house | "a mercantile profession", earning very well | | Ch 50 | Mars in Capricorn exchanged with Saturn, Venus in the 2nd therefrom | "a very high post in a concern dealing with wines and drinks"
Effect of the rule: The named occupation.
Combination of the rule: Saturn's sign and its occupants are read together with the sign's subject matter (RAO-KRK-050).

Rule description: The Sun anywhere in Saturn's frame gives government service
Exact rule: Three positions, all giving government service: - 11th from Saturn — Ch 54, "The Sun in 11th to Saturn shows a Government job." - 2nd from Saturn — Ch 27, "With the Sun in 2nd to Saturn … the native will be a Government employee." - Next house, with Saturn exalted — Ch 37, "the planet of profession i.e. Saturn is in exaltation and has Sun and Mercury in the house next to him. Hence, the native will be employed in Government holding a high post."
Effect of the rule: Government employment, high or ordinary according to Saturn's strength.
Combination of the rule: The Sun stands in a marked relation to Saturn.

Rule description: Two or three occupations in sequence, read from successive contacts
Exact rule: Careers in this book are routinely two or three trades in sequence, each keyed to a contact: - Ch 36 — Ketu in Capricorn gives "a life of renunciation"; then Mars in Aquarius → "he will practise Ayurveda for some time"; then "the contact with the Moon later indicates dealing in chemicals"; then "Saturn next meets Rahu and later Mercury in exaltation — indicating owning a house, and earning plenty of money from 44-45 onwards." - Ch 53 — first employment at 24, rise at 30, then "with Mars in Gemini, he will later on take up printing, machinery work and do business." - Ch 45 — a public institution first, "where he may not earn much or feel happy", then "some time later, he will get employment in a cloth mill."
Effect of the rule: A sequence of occupations across the working life.
Combination of the rule: Saturn meets a run of planets over the working years.

Rule description: Venus–Saturn exchange: change of profession
Exact rule: "Further, Venus and Saturn have exchanged places. So he may change his profession."
Effect of the rule: A change of profession, and later great fame in the same field.
Combination of the rule: Venus and Saturn have exchanged signs.

Rule description: The native steps into his father's place
Exact rule: A recurring and very practical verdict, with the mechanism named each time: - Ch 94 — "With Saturn in the 2nd from the Sun the native will step into his father's place and work there. Jupiter and Ketu in 7th to Saturn show that the native will outshine his father and amass money." - Ch 77 — "as there is Venus in the 2nd house to the Sun, aspected by Jupiter, the native will occupy a high place in his father's sphere of activity." - Ch 100 — "He will follow the profession of his father … He will outshine both his father and grandfather." - Ch 88 — "The native will take up the same profession as that of his father."
Effect of the rule: The father's trade continued, and often surpassed.
Combination of the rule: A karaka links the native's frame to the Sun's.

Rule description: Saturn with Jupiter and Ketu: the medical and chemical line
Exact rule: The most consistent single career signature in this batch — six charts, one answer: | Chart | Configuration | Result | |---|---|---| | Ch 72 | Saturn in his own sign with Jupiter, Ketu in the next house | "the department … will be medical or concerned with chemicals" | | Ch 74 | Jupiter conjunct Saturn, Ketu in the 2nd, Venus in the 7th from Saturn | "the native will occupy the highest place in a medical institution" | | Ch 77 | Saturn conjunct Ketu with Jupiter in the next sign | "the native will also work in the medical line" | | Ch 75 | Saturn conjunct Jupiter and Ketu, Moon in the 2nd to Saturn | a religious institution, and "friends dealing in chemicals" | | Ch 68 | Jupiter and Saturn in the 7th from the Sun | the father's "profession as a pharmaceutical concern" | | Ch 89 | Saturn contacts the Sun first in his movement | "the native will earn through medical preparations"
Effect of the rule: Medicine, pharmacy, chemicals.
Combination of the rule: Saturn conjunct Jupiter and/or Ketu; or Ketu in the sign after Saturn.

Rule description: Treasury, accounts and audit from Mercury, Venus and Saturn
Exact rule: Ch 84 — "From the position of the Sun, Venus is in the 2nd in exaltation and is conjunct Saturn, indicating service in a Treasury." - Ch 93 — "As Mars is in Dravyalaya (11th) from the Sun, her husband will be employed in the treasury section and hold a high post." - Ch 85 — "The presence of Rahu in Mars' house adjoining the position of Saturn indicates employment in an institute or treasury." - Ch 95 — "The native will serve as an Auditor in a Treasury Department." - Ch 102 — "He will work … in the accounts section of an industrial concern."
Effect of the rule: Treasury, accounts, audit.
Combination of the rule: Venus or Mercury in the 2nd or 11th from Saturn or the Sun.

Rule description: Obstruction to employment from Saturn with Mars
Exact rule: "Saturn-Mars combination gives obstructions in obtaining a job. He will also follow his brothers in profession. Wrong attachments will drain away his finances. He will settle down from 27th year onwards with no definite income" (Ch 61). Ch 65: "He will try many jobs; but have failures in all, will finally settle down in a Government Technical Institute."
Effect of the rule: Repeated failures, then a late and modest settlement.
Combination of the rule: Saturn–Mars combination, the two being enemies.

Rule description: The definitive statement of the empty-frame rule
Exact rule: Chart 125 states it more completely than anywhere else in the book: > "Saturn in Sagittarius has no planets placed in the preceding and succeeding houses nor in the > 7th, i.e., opposite house. He contacts only Rahu in Pisces and has no planets to contact till he > reaches Cancer. The native will have poor education, will have to struggle hard and then will > get a low paid job." And Chart 142 gives the extreme case with a duration attached: "Jupiter is conjunct Ketu and Mars … and there are no planets in four preceding and four succeeding houses. He will, therefore, be a wanderer from childhood till he attains the age of 30."
Effect of the rule: Struggle, low employment, wandering — for as long as the emptiness runs.
Combination of the rule: A karaka has no planets in the preceding sign, the succeeding sign, or the 7th, and no contacts ahead of it for several signs.

Rule description: Further occupations named
Exact rule: Added to RAO-PRF-005, RAO-PRF-013, RAO-PRF-018 and RAO-PRF-019: | Occupation | Signature | Chart | |---|---|---| | Aviation / airways | Saturn contacting Rahu in the 4th, or Rahu in a dual sign | Ch 121, 130 | | Surgery | Jupiter meeting Mars in the next sign | Ch 113 | | Rice and edible commodities | Sun conjunct Jupiter with the Moon in the 7th | Ch 109 | | Coconuts, vegetables, "juicy things" | Mercury in Cancer opposed by Saturn | Ch 144 | | Restaurant / eatables | Debilitated Sun with Mercury and Rahu, Moon in Scorpio | Ch 111 | | Silver idols and Japa beads | Saturn contacting the Moon first, aspected by exalted Jupiter | Ch 126 | | Capital investment / finance corporation | Saturn contacting Rahu then Jupiter | Ch 132 | | Cinema | — (with meagre salary) | Ch 138 | | Publicity and teaching | Saturn fortified by Venus and Jupiter's aspect | Ch 121 | | Land development | Saturn conjunct Jupiter, Ketu next aspected by Mars | Ch 71 | | Talismans and incantations | — | Ch 141 | | Wandering preacher | Saturn's contact with the Sun giving "Universal vision in a Royal background" | Ch 123
Effect of the rule: A named trade.

Rule description: The empty frame, third form: dependence and servitude
Exact rule: Three distinct verdicts, and the distinction between them matters: - Nothing anywhere in the frame → dependence. Ch 168: "With no planets on either side or in the 7th, Saturn has made the native to be dependent on others." - Nothing in the 7th alone → self-reliance. Ch 162: "There are no planets in the seventh to him, hence he will have to depend on himself." - Flanked by the nodes → servitude. Ch 162: "Saturn has Rahu-Ketu on either side, hence the native is a servant" (RAO-KRK-088).
Effect of the rule: Dependence, self-reliance, or servitude.
Combination of the rule: Variants of the empty or blocked frame around Saturn.

Rule description: Lordship of the 2nd from Saturn names the concern
Exact rule: "As Mars, the lord of the 2nd house from Saturn, is in conjunction with Rahu, he will be employed in an Intelligence Bureau and play an important role by his intellectual ability." And Ch 193 chains the device: "Jupiter has Saturn in the second house to him. Mercury is in the second to Saturn. Further, Mercury has Venus and Mars in the second to him. The native will consequently have to take up manufacture of medicines from drugs and chemicals."
Effect of the rule: The concern the native works in, named through the lord.
Combination of the rule: The lord of the 2nd house from Saturn is located and read.

Rule description: Further occupations named
Exact rule: Added to RAO-PRF-022: | Occupation | Signature | Chart | |---|---|---| | Intelligence Bureau | Lord of the 2nd from Saturn conjunct Rahu | Ch 186 | | Expert surgeon / qualified doctor | Mercury contacting Jupiter and Rahu then Ketu opposite, Jupiter in a Mars sign | Ch 170 | | Compounder, then chemist's shop | — | Ch 160 | | Tailoring and cloth | Ketu–Moon conjunction (RAO-KRK-092) | Ch 167, 161 | | Sewage by-products | Moon in Pisces with Saturn | Ch 184 | | Tractors and farm vehicles | Jupiter meeting Rahu then Saturn | Ch 172 | | Commission agency / mediation | Mercury with Saturn and Mars next | Ch 166, 175 | | Fruit juices and drinks | Saturn contacting Venus in Mercury's house, then the Sun in Cancer | Ch 183 | | Art, music, dancing, drama, public entertainment | Saturn contacting Venus in Cancer | Ch 196 | | Publication of books on hidden texts | An unbroken chain of occupied signs (RAO-KRK-082) | Ch 196 | | Village accountant and priest | Sun + Mercury + Ketu in Taurus, Mars in Gemini; Venus–Mercury exchange (RAO-KRK-086) | Ch 195
Effect of the rule: A named trade.

Rule description: Further occupations named
Exact rule: Added to RAO-PRF-022 and RAO-PRF-025. Note how consistently the trade is composed rather than looked up (RAO-PRF-005, RAO-KRK-103): | Occupation | Signature | Chart | |---|---|---| | Secret government organisation | Saturn in Mercury's house; Sun, Venus and Rahu in the 2nd from Saturn | Ch 274 | | News publishing | Saturn and Jupiter transiting Rahu's sign, the lord of that sign being the Sun | Ch 245 | | Typist in a government department | — | Ch 267 | | Precious articles made by machinery | Exalted Jupiter (precious) + Mars (machinery) + Venus (splendour), with Rahu then the Sun (light) | Ch 252 | | Ornaments from forest products | Saturn (luxury) with Mars (destroying), Rahu a blockade, Jupiter–Sun exchange (forest), then Venus and Mercury | Ch 270 | | Sale of medicines | Saturn in Gemini (commerce) with Jupiter and Rahu next — "essences of drugs and chemicals" | Ch 265 | | Grain and fish | Mercury–Moon exchange giving Mercury exaltation in Virgo (RAO-JTC-035) | Ch 215 | | Foodstuffs | Jupiter with Rahu (the mouth) in Cancer (watery), 2nd from Saturn | Ch 264 | | Warm liquid materials | Saturn in Venus's house, Venus–Mars exchange | Ch 253 | | Money lending | — | Ch 229 | | Rice and sugar | Jupiter (sweet) + Venus (sour) + Mercury (business) in the 2nd from Saturn | Ch 251 | | Junior Health Inspector | Saturn conjunct Ketu, Jupiter and Mars in the previous house | Ch 227 | | Contracts in motor vehicles | — | Ch 250 | | Astrology and medicine | Saturn transiting Rahu's position then the Moon's | Ch 225 | | Speech-related profession | Jupiter and Mars in Pisces, Saturn and Ketu in the 2nd | Ch 224 | | Cheating and fraud | Saturn transiting Rahu's and the Moon's positions | Ch 224
Effect of the rule: A named trade.

Rule description: Saturn retrograde: forced changes of profession
Exact rule: "The combination of Saturn and Jupiter indicates a gentle profession for the native. As Saturn is retrograde the native may be forced to change professions now and then." Ch 248 gives the mechanism plainly: "Saturn has moved into Aries from Taurus in retrogression" — i.e. he works from the previous sign (RAO-JTC-029). Ch 266: "Saturn the significator of profession instead of moving forward turns back in retrogression."
Effect of the rule: Repeated changes of work.

Rule description: Every karaka isolated: a life of unbroken misery
Exact rule: The extreme case of RAO-PRF-012 and RAO-PRF-021, and Rao states it as a cumulative sum: > "There are no planets in the adjacent houses to Jupiter. The native will, therefore, be weak > and pass through many dangerous periods during his early days. … Venus has no planets in the > adjacent houses, so the native will be married in his 32nd year. … Mars and Saturn have no > planets in the adjacent houses. Mercury, Venus and the Sun also have no planets in the adjacent > houses. Jupiter, too, has no planets in the adjacent houses. Consequently the native's life will > be one of misery."
Effect of the rule: Every department of life unsupported.
Combination of the rule: No planets in the adjacent houses of ANY karaka.

Rule description: The 2nd from a planet is its income and its substance
Exact rule: The most-used wealth device in the corpus, and it works from any karaka: - Ch 1 — "The placement of Mercury and Saturn in the 2nd to the Sun indicates sources of income" — but "both the planets are opposed by a strong Mars who is an enemy and so the income was meagre." - Ch 2 — "with the placement of Mars and Venus in the 2nd house to Saturn, he will own house, have conveyances and earn well." - Ch 41 — "Venus in the 2nd house to Ketu and Jupiter indicates wealth got through his wife."
Effect of the rule: Income, and the channel it arrives through.
Combination of the rule: A planet occupies the sign immediately after the karaka's.

Rule description: The 11th from a planet gives earning and gain
Exact rule: Ch 32 — "Venus 11th to Saturn indicates earning of wealth." - Ch 34 — "Venus occupies the 11th from Jupiter. This position of Venus indicates that the native will have conveyances and good finances." - Ch 54 — "The Sun in 11th to Saturn shows a Government job."
Effect of the rule: Earnings, gains, conveyances.
Combination of the rule: A planet occupies the 11th from the karaka.

Rule description: Venus names the commodity
Exact rule: Venus supplies the goods; her company supplies the trade: | Chart | Configuration | The commodity | |---|---|---| | Ch 33 | Sun exalted in Aries, Taurus — "the house of jewellery and finance" — holding its owner Venus with Mercury | The father "will be dealing in jewellery and will earn a lot" | | Ch 55 | — | "He will deal in diamonds and gold jewellery" | | Ch 9 | Saturn meets Venus + Mercury, then Sun, Mars, Rahu | "money lender and dealer in jewellery" | | Ch 50 | Mars–Saturn exchange, Venus in the 2nd therefrom | "a very high post in a concern dealing with wines and drinks" | | Ch 6 | Saturn meets Rahu, then Venus and the Moon | "he deals in drinks and dresses" | | Ch 31 | Venus + Mercury + Saturn | "He will be a dealer in wines and drinks"
Effect of the rule: The named commodity.
Combination of the rule: Venus stands in the wealth frame, alone or with others.

Rule description: Money earned but not retained
Exact rule: Rao distinguishes earning from keeping, and states them separately: - Ch 58 — "Venus, his friend, is in Aries which is a debilitation point for Saturn. Hence, he will spend away what he earns. He will be duped by many." - Ch 43 — "He may earn large amounts but money will not stay in his hands." - Ch 18 — empty adjacency to Saturn: "He will be greatly in debts."
Effect of the rule: Earnings dissipated; debt.
Combination of the rule: The karaka of wealth is weak, debilitated, or without support in its frame.

Rule description: Land from Mars and Saturn; the house from Jupiter's contact
Exact rule: Land — Ch 1, "Saturn in the 2nd house to the Sun, aspected directly by Mars, clearly indicates one owning some lands"; Ch 26, "since Mars occupies the next house to the Sun, owned by him, the father will have some landed property"; Ch 34, "Mars in his own house and Rahu with Saturn indicate owning some acres of dry land"; Ch 44, "Mars in Pisces … shows financial gains through lands." - The house, and its date — Ch 44, "In his 40-41st year, the native comes into possession of an old house, when Jupiter during his fourth round transits Mercury"; Ch 49, "At the age of 45-46, he will own a house"; Ch 56, "by 47-48 he will own a house and have landed property."
Effect of the rule: Landed property and a dwelling, with a date.

Rule description: Water works on the land, from Saturn's contact order
Exact rule: A beautifully specific reading, and a good demonstration of RAO-JTC-007: "Saturn contacts the Moon in Aquarius and Ketu in Pisces after his contact with Mars, and so by the help of pumping sets and sinking wells, he will obtain good yield from his lands."
Effect of the rule: Irrigation, wells, and a yield from land that was dry.
Combination of the rule: Saturn contacts the Moon and Ketu after contacting Mars.

Rule description: Inherited property, and its loss
Exact rule: "Since Venus has the Sun and Mars next to him, the native will acquire paternal property also (legacy)" (Ch 9). "The native will gain parental property including lands" (Ch 12). "The father lost all property on account of his quarrelsome nature, and his sister being left without children he came to possess that property" (Ch 15).
Effect of the rule: Inheritance received, lost, litigated, or recovered by another route.
Combination of the rule: The Sun (father) and the planets around him are read for what descends.

Rule description: Foreign travel from Rahu, the Moon and Ketu
Exact rule: Ch 1 — Jupiter conjoining Rahu, aspected by the Moon from the 7th, with Cancer (Jupiter's exaltation, the Moon's sign) next: travel from 41–42, continuing "until Jupiter crosses over Leo." - Ch 16 — "The Moon in exaltation with Ketu in the next house shows that the native will have foreign travels on 3 occasions, two of which will be fruitful." - Ch 60 — the lonely Jupiter across the nodal axis (RAO-KRK-052): "He will go to a foreign country." - Ch 36 — "The good period will continue upto the age of 60 when he may undertake foreign journeys." - Ch 41 — "About 58-59 he may go to foreign countries."
Effect of the rule: Journeys abroad, their number, and whether they profit.
Combination of the rule: Rahu, the Moon or Ketu enter the frame of the native's karaka.

Rule description: Migration from the native place
Exact rule: Ch 45 — "Since the second house to the Sun is aspected by Jupiter the native will migrate from his native place of birth." - Ch 40 — "As Jupiter is Retrograde, he will gain fame in a place other than his native place" (RAO-KRK-049). - Ch 55 — "This native will be born in one place and migrate to another and earn his livelihood there." - Ch 38 — "He will renovate his old place at the age of 56-57, migrate to a new place and start life afresh."
Effect of the rule: Departure from the birthplace; a livelihood made elsewhere.
Combination of the rule: The 2nd from the Sun aspected by Jupiter; or natal Jupiter retrograde.

Rule description: Conveyances
Exact rule: "he will own house, have conveyances and earn well" (Ch 2, Venus 2nd from Saturn); "the native will have conveyances and good finances" (Ch 34, Venus 11th from Jupiter); "he will also deal in conveyances … as an employee in that concern" (Ch 6); "Jupiter, Rahu and Mars in consecutive houses show accounting relating to conveyances and earning therefrom" (Ch 54); "He will enjoy Raja Yoga from 28 to 55, when he will have conveyances" (Ch 40).
Effect of the rule: Vehicles owned, or a livelihood made from them.
Combination of the rule: Venus in the frame, especially the 2nd or 11th from the karaka.

Rule description: Vehicles as a trade, from a run of signs behind Saturn
Exact rule: Ch 83 — "The native will earn well by business in vehicles (cars etc.) as Saturn is followed by Rahu, Mars, the Moon and Jupiter, one in each sign." - Ch 78 — "He will deal in conveyances (cars etc.) and will earn much as Mars and Rahu in Cancer are in the 4th from Mercury in Aries." - Ch 87 — "The second house from the Sun is occupied by Mars, Saturn and Rahu. The father earns riches by sale of vehicles." - Ch 94 — "The native will shine in an automobile institution and earn much."
Effect of the rule: A livelihood in vehicles.
Combination of the rule: A run of consecutively occupied signs following Saturn (RAO-KRK-057), or Mars and Rahu in the 4th from Mercury.

Rule description: Hidden and secreted wealth
Exact rule: "He will deposit money in a secret place" (Ch 84). Ch 98 builds a whole episode from it — the third wife of the father "came into possession of hidden wealth" — and then qualifies it: "As the planet in the house of Venus is Jupiter aspected by Saturn, a large part of the hidden wealth would have been spent in a bad way."
Effect of the rule: Concealed wealth, largely dissipated.
Combination of the rule: Venus exalted and conjunct Saturn in the 2nd from the Sun; or Venus, lord of Jupiter's sign, beside the Sun in a watery sign.

Rule description: Property built and sold, rather than held
Exact rule: "He will build houses and sell them away — he will live by Jupiter's help i.e. be lucky" (Ch 92). Ch 54: "At 41-42 he will come to own a house but he will not live in it. He will sell away the house at 54-55. Two daughters will inherit the amount." Ch 64: "He will have pump sets for the property earned by his father and get lot of money through them."
Effect of the rule: Property acquired, turned over, and passed on.
